product.description: A white-label digital banking platform integrating banking, investments, and wealth management for affluent customers of banks and credit unions.

identifier.value: Consumer and Small Business Digital Banking Accounts

product.name: Consumer and Small Business Digital Banking Accounts
product.description: Digital banking accounts for consumers and small businesses featuring digital onboarding, multiple virtual cards, joint accounts, and security tools.

product.name: Investment Portfolios
product.description: Personalized investment portfolios including robo-advisory, fixed income, alternative investments, and tax-loss harvesting.

product.name: Digital Wealth Management
product.description: A low-touch digital wealth management solution with AI-driven personal finance recommendations and net worth tracking.

product.name: Marketing and Loyalty Programs
product.description: Member referral programs and merchant-funded cashback and benefits integrated into the banking app.

product.name: High Yield Cash Sweep Account
product.description: A high liquidity cash sweep account offering over 4% annual yield with no minimum balance and two-day clearing.
